DUME.purpose: The commissioning harness source. Control-plane changes are separate work, never a side effect of a target work package.

AETHRION_SPEC.purpose: Authoritative commissioning specification. Read-only to every build agent. UNBOUND until a human binds it.

AETHRION_TARGET.purpose: The implementation under construction. Written only through an assigned worktree. UNBOUND until a human binds it.

EVIDENCE.purpose: Commissioning receipts. Prior failed evidence is never destroyed by a retry.

MODEL_CACHE.purpose: Model weights, outside Git. Root filesystem cannot hold them.

notes: JSON rather than TOML/YAML: the host runs Python 3.10 (no stdlib tomllib) and DUM-E foundation must have zero third-party dependencies.
